Hand evaluation arrives first for Texas Hold\'em (phase 5); Omaha, Omaha Hi-Lo, Stud, Draw and Short Deck engines follow in phase 9. The selection is already used for game-state validation rules.
A trained card-detection model is not bundled yet. The app will not show card detections until one is installed. No mock results are displayed.
How many camera frames per second are analysed. Higher values react faster but use more battery.
Detections below this are ignored as noise.
Detections at or above this can be confirmed without your review. Anything between the two values is shown as uncertain and must be confirmed or corrected.
Images and video are processed on this device.
The app does not request internet access; nothing is uploaded.
Imported and captured media is copied into private app storage, invisible to other apps.
All stored images, videos, games and hand histories will be permanently deleted and settings reset. Originals in your gallery are not affected.
Exporting your game history (hand histories and reports) is planned together with statistics.
